review: summary: The term 'consent agenda' requires the English in parentheses the first time it appears in a text: 'agenda de consentimiento (consent agenda)'. In the summary, 'agenda de consentimiento' appears without the parenthetical English. Also, the English says 'Consent items', and the translation adds 'de la agenda' which is acceptable, but the parenthetical is missing.
